info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Payoff Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access and list payoff amounts for various mortgage loans. This service caters to lenders, loan servicers, and financial institutions seeking to manage and track loan payout information accurately. By providing essential payoff details, this API supports operational transparency and facilitates informed decision-making during the loan payoff process. Typical use cases include preparing for loan closures and managing client inquiries regarding payoff balances.

get.summary: Retrieve the payoff amount for a loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current payoff amount for a specified loan. It provides necessary financial details for users who wish to understand how much they need to pay off their loan completely.

requestBody.description: This request is used to initiate a payoff process for loans. It requires relevant loan information to determine the payoff amount and the applicable terms. Ensure that all necessary loan identifiers are provided in the request body.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns loan payoff details.

ListMortgageLoansPayoffsRequest.description: Represents the payload sent in the request body for the GET operation related to loan payoff. This string is typically a JSON formatted string containing key-value pairs.
